condition.description: Whether received units are fit to stock. Only `Good` is handed to inventory-storage.
condition.title: Condition

countedContents.description:
Optional audit count of a MIXED carton, only with an SSCC scan
(a count on a homogeneous carton is 422 `counted-contents-not-mixed`).
The quantity RECEIVED is the counted one, never the label's; every
SKU whose count differs from the manifest raises
`MixedCartonContentMismatch`. A manifest SKU absent from the count
counts as zero; a SKU the manifest does not list needs an each GTIN
in the PackagingView (else 422 `counted-sku-unknown`).

qty.description: Eaches counted; 0 = looked for and found none.
